ideas.title: The Scope of Minnesota's Fraud Problem

ideas.angle: A deep dive into the data and cases to understand the scope of the problem.
questions: What is the total amount of alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: Understanding the scope of the problem will help identify patterns and potential areas for further investigation.
